description: This file defines the ProductsController class in an ASP.NET Core Web API project. The class provides CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for Product resources, including endpoints for getting all products, retrieving a product by ID, creating a new product, updating an existing product, and deleting a product. It interacts with an IProductRepository for data access and uses attributes for routing, validation, and documentation.

classes.name: ProductsController
classes.description: Controller providing CRUD operations for products in an ASP.NET Core Web API. It handles HTTP requests related to product data and utilizes dependency injection for repository and logger services.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve all products.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a product by its ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new product based on the provided DTO.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing product identified by ID.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to delete a product by its ID.
